name: LM Studio Provider
description: A Drupal AI provider for LM Studio (run local LLMs).
project_description:
Need a flexible AI solution you can run locally? LMStudio offers a powerful GUI and the ability to run AI models directly on your local machine for testing and development. Integrated with the AI module , LMStudio allows you to test and tweak models in a controlled environment before deploying them at scale.

 Features 
 LMStudio offers a flexible, user-friendly GUI for testing and managing AI models locally. Perfect for developers and data scientists who want to experiment with AI models before integrating them into production, LMStudio works seamlessly with the AI module to bring your local testing workflows to life.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Set up your API key using the Key module, pointing to your local instance of LMStudio. 
 Navigate to /admin/config/ai/providers/lmstudio and link the API key you created. 
 With the setup complete, you can start running and testing models directly from your local machine. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 The AI module .

 Supporting this Module 
 Support the AI module on OpenCollective .

 Community Documentation 
 The documentation is available on https://project.pages.drupalcode.org/ai/
